programs.source:
need =: 4 : 0
    multiplier =. ('qty_per' get_key x)*100+'scrap' get_key x
    ((y*multiplier)+99) div 100
)
search_path =: 3 : 0
    if. y-:SearchTarget do. <y return. end.
    SearchVisited =: SearchVisited,<y
    for_box. y get_key Children do.
        child =. 'child' get_key >box
        if. (<child)e.SearchVisited do. continue. end.
        rest =. search_path child
        if. #rest do. (<y),rest return. end.
    end.
    0$a:
)
read_bom =: 3 : 0
    Children =: Parents =: empty_table ''
    for_idbox. table_keys Items do.
        Children =: (idbox,<0$a:) put_key Children
        Parents =: (idbox,<0$a:) put_key Parents
    end.
    for_box. read_rows 'bom.csv' do.
        'line fields' =. >box
        'parent child quantitytext scraptext' =. fields
        quantity =. num quantitytext
        scrap =. num scraptext
        reason =. ''
        if. -.parent has_key Items do. reason =. 'unknown item ',parent
        elseif. -.child has_key Items do. reason =. 'unknown item ',child
        elseif. quantity<1 do. reason =. 'bad quantity ',number quantity
        elseif. scrap>50 do. reason =. 'bad scrap ',number scrap
        elseif. parent-:child do. reason =. 'cycle ',parent,' -> ',parent
        else.
            for_rowbox. parent get_key Children do.
                if. child-:'child' get_key >rowbox do. reason =. 'duplicate ',parent,' -> ',child
                break. end.
            end.
            if. 0=#reason do.
                SearchTarget =: parent
                SearchVisited =: 0$a:
                path =. search_path child
                if. #path do. reason =. 'cycle ',parent,' -> ',' -> ' join path end.
            end.
        end.
        if. #reason do. 'bom.csv' record_error (<line),<reason
        else.
            row =. 'parent child qty_per scrap' record (<parent),(<child),(<quantity),<scrap
            children =. 'child' sort_records (parent get_key Children),<row
            parents =. 'parent' sort_records (child get_key Parents),<row
            Children =: ((<parent),<children) put_key Children
            Parents =: ((<child),<parents) put_key Parents
        end.
    end.
    i.0
)
low_code =: 3 : 0
    if. y has_key LowCodes do. y get_key LowCodes return. end.
    value =. 0
    for_box. y get_key Parents do. value =. value>.1+low_code 'parent' get_key >box end.
    LowCodes =: ((<y),<value) put_key LowCodes
    value
)
cumulative_lead =: 3 : 0
    if. y has_key Cumulative do. y get_key Cumulative return. end.
    longest =. 0
    for_box. y get_key Children do. longest =. longest>.cumulative_lead 'child' get_key >box end.
    value =. longest+'lead_time' get_key y get_key Items
    Cumulative =: ((<y),<value) put_key Cumulative
    value
)
analyze_bom =: 3 : 0
    LowCodes =: Cumulative =: empty_table ''
    for_box. ItemIds do.
        low_code >box
        cumulative_lead >box
    end.
    codes =. 0$0
    for_box. ItemIds do. codes =. codes,(>box) get_key LowCodes end.
    PlanningOrder =: (/:codes,.i.#codes){ItemIds
    i.0
)

read_workcenters =: 3 : 0
    Centers =: empty_table ''
    for_box. read_rows 'workcenters.csv' do.
        'line fields' =. >box
        'id minutetext efficiencytext description' =. fields
        minutes =. num minutetext
        efficiency =. num efficiencytext
        reason =. ''
        if. id has_key Centers do. reason =. 'duplicate center ',id
        elseif. (efficiency<50)+.efficiency>150 do. reason =. 'bad efficiency ',number efficiency end.
        if. #reason do. 'workcenters.csv' record_error (<line),<reason
        else.
            values =. (<id),(<minutes),(<efficiency),(<(minutes*efficiency) div 100),<description
            center =. 'id minutes efficiency available description' record values
            Centers =: ((<id),<center) put_key Centers
        end.
    end.
    CenterIds =: /:~table_keys Centers
    i.0
)
read_routings =: 3 : 0
    Routings =: empty_table ''
    for_box. ItemIds do. Routings =: (box,<0$a:) put_key Routings end.
    for_box. read_rows 'routings.csv' do.
        'line fields' =. >box
        'id numbertext center setuptext runtext' =. fields
        numbervalue =. num numbertext
        run =. num runtext
        reason =. ''
        if. -.id has_key Items do. reason =. 'unknown item ',id
        elseif. -.center has_key Centers do. reason =. 'unknown center ',center
        elseif. 0=#id get_key Children do. reason =. 'purchased item ',id
        elseif. run<1 do. reason =. 'bad run time ',number run
        else.
            for_operationbox. id get_key Routings do.
                if. numbervalue='number' get_key >operationbox do. reason =. 'duplicate ',id,' operation ',number numbervalue
                break. end.
            end.
        end.
        if. #reason do. 'routings.csv' record_error (<line),<reason
        else.
            operation =. 'item number center setup run' record (<id),(<numbervalue),(<center),(<num setuptext),<run
            operations =. (id get_key Routings),<operation
            numbers =. 0$0
            for_operationbox. operations do. numbers =. numbers,'number' get_key >operationbox end.
            Routings =: ((<id),<( /:numbers){operations) put_key Routings
        end.
    end.
    i.0
)
operation_week =: 3 : 0
    'receipt lead index count' =. y
    1>.(receipt-lead)+(index*lead) div count
)
operation_minutes =: 4 : '(''setup'' get_key x)+y*''run'' get_key x'
level_loads =: 4 : 0
    leveled =. (#y)$0
    carry =. 0
    for_week. |.>:i.(#y)-1 do.
        total =. (week{y)+carry
        used =. x<.total
        leveled =. used week}leveled
        carry =. total-used
    end.
    (({.y)+carry) 0}leveled
)

standard_costs =: 3 : 0
    Costs =: empty_table ''
    for_idbox. |.PlanningOrder do.
        id =. >idbox
        item =. id get_key Items
        material =. 'material' get_key item
        labor =. 'labor' get_key item
        for_box. id get_key Children do.
            row =. >box
            child =. ('child' get_key row) get_key Costs
            multiplier =. ('qty_per' get_key row)*100+'scrap' get_key row
            material =. material+((multiplier*'material' get_key child)+50) div 100
            labor =. labor+((multiplier*'labor' get_key child)+50) div 100
        end.
        cost =. 'material labor total' record (<material),(<labor),<material+labor
        Costs =: ((<id),<cost) put_key Costs
    end.
    i.0
)
abc_classes =: 3 : 0
    values =. 0$0
    for_box. ItemIds do. values =. values,(>box) get_key y end.
    total =. +/values
    order =. /:(-values),.i.#values
    classes =. empty_table ''
    before =. 0
    for_index. order do.
        value =. index{values
        if. value=0 do. class =. 'C'
        elseif. (100*before)<80*total do. class =. 'A'
        elseif. (100*before)<95*total do. class =. 'B'
        else. class =. 'C' end.
        classes =. ((index{ItemIds),<class) put_key classes
        before =. before+value
    end.
    classes
)

LotRules =: ' ' split 'LFL FOQ POQ MIN'
lot_values =: 4 : 0
    values =. num&>'/' split y
    if. x-:'LFL' do. fits =. ((#values)=1)*.0={.values
    elseif. x-:'MIN' do. fits =. ((#values)=2)*.*./values>:1
    else. fits =. ((#values)=1)*.1<:{.values end.
    (<fits),<values
)
lot_label =: 3 : 0
    rule =. 'rule' get_key y
    if. rule-:'LFL' do. rule return. end.
    values =. 'lot' get_key y
    if. rule-:'MIN' do. rule,' ',(number 0{values),'/',number 1{values
    else. rule,' ',number {.values end.
)
read_items =: 3 : 0
    Items =: empty_table ''
    for_box. read_rows 'items.csv' do.
        'line fields' =. >box
        'id leadtext rule lottext safetytext handtext materialtext labortext description' =. fields
        reason =. ''
        lot =. 0$0
        if. id has_key Items do. reason =. 'duplicate item ',id
        elseif. -.(<rule)e.LotRules do. reason =. 'unknown lot rule ',rule
        else.
            'fits lot' =. rule lot_values lottext
            if. -.fits do. reason =. 'bad lot parameter ',lottext,' for ',rule end.
        end.
        if. #reason do. 'items.csv' record_error (<line),<reason
        else.
            values =. (<id),(<num leadtext),(<rule),(<lot),(<num safetytext),(<num handtext),(<num materialtext),(<num labortext),<description
            item =. 'id lead_time rule lot safety_stock on_hand material labor description' record values
            Items =: ((<id),<item) put_key Items
        end.
    end.
    i.0
)

smallest_multiple =: 4 : 'y*(x+y-1) div y'
lot_size =: 4 : 0
    'week projected receipts gross' =. y
    safety =. 'safety_stock' get_key x
    net =. safety-projected
    rule =. 'rule' get_key x
    values =. 'lot' get_key x
    if. rule-:'LFL' do. net return. end.
    if. rule-:'FOQ' do. net smallest_multiple {.values return. end.
    if. rule-:'MIN' do. (net>.0{values) smallest_multiple 1{values return. end.
    quantity =. net
    finish =. Horizon<.week+{.values
    for_later. (week+1)+i.0>.finish-(week+1) do.
        projected =. projected+(later{receipts)-later{gross
        quantity =. quantity>.safety-projected
    end.
    quantity
)

ScriptPath =: >{:4!:3''
SourceDirectory =: (1+>./_1,I.ScriptPath e.'/\'){.ScriptPath
Digits =: '0123456789'
div =: 4 : '_1 x:<.(x:x)%x:y'
num =: 3 : '10#.Digits i.y'
number =: 3 : 0
    if. y<0 do. '-',number -y return. end.
    text =. ''
    while. y>0 do.
        text =. ((10|y){Digits),text
        y =. y div 10
    end.
    if. #text do. text else. '0' end.
)
pad2 =: 3 : '_2{.''00'',number y'
split =: 4 : 0
    parts =. 0$a:
    while. 1 do.
        position =. y i.x
        parts =. parts,<position{.y
        if. position=#y do. parts return. end.
        y =. (position+1)}.y
    end.
)
join =: 4 : 0
    text =. ''
    for_index. i.#y do.
        if. index do. text =. text,x end.
        text =. text,index{::y
    end.
    text
)
read_lines =: 3 : '<;._2 (1!:1 <''input/'',y)'
read_rows =: 3 : 0
    lines =. }.read_lines y
    rows =. 0$a:
    for_index. i.#lines do. rows =. rows,<(<index+2),<',' split index{::lines end.
    rows
)
empty_table =: 3 : '0 2$a:'
table_keys =: 3 : '0{"1 y'
has_key =: 4 : '(<x)e.table_keys y'
get_key =: 4 : '((table_keys y)i.<x){::1{"1 y'
put_key =: 4 : 0
    'key value' =. x
    position =. (table_keys y)i.<key
    if. position<#y do. (<value) (<position,1)}y
    else. y,1 2$(<key),<value end.
)
record =: 4 : '('' '' split x),.y'
sort_records =: 4 : 0
    keys =. 0$a:
    for_box. y do. keys =. keys,<x get_key >box end.
    (/:keys){y
)
record_error =: 4 : 0
    'line reason' =. y
    Errors =: Errors,<x,' line ',(number line),': ',reason
    i.0
)
load SourceDirectory,'items.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'bom.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'lot_sizing.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'capacity.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'costing.ijs'
load SourceDirectory,'report.ijs'

DemandKinds =: ' ' split 'MPS ORDER DEPENDENT'
RootKinds =: ' ' split 'MPS ORDER SAFETY'
SupplyKinds =: ' ' split 'STOCK RECEIPT ORDER'
MessageKinds =: ' ' split 'BELOW_SAFETY PAST_DUE RELEASE EXPEDITE DEFER CANCEL NO_ROUTING NO_DEMAND OVERLOAD'
new_demand =: 3 : '''item kind week quantity order_id line parent parent_number'' record y'
read_params =: 3 : 0
    for_box. read_lines 'params.txt' do.
        words =. ' ' split >box
        select. 0{::words
        case. 'horizon' do. Horizon =: num 1{::words
        case. 'peg' do. PegItems =: }.words
        case. 'tree_quantity' do. TreeQuantity =: num 1{::words
        end.
    end.
    Weeks =: >:i.Horizon
    i.0
)
schedule_error =: 3 : 0
    'id week quantity' =. y
    if. -.id has_key Items do. 'unknown item ',id
    elseif. (week<1)+.week>Horizon do. 'week ',(number week),' outside horizon'
    elseif. quantity<1 do. 'bad quantity ',number quantity
    else. '' end.
)
read_schedule =: 3 : 0
    rows =. seen =. 0$a:
    for_box. read_rows y do.
        'line fields' =. >box
        id =. 0{::fields
        week =. num 1{::fields
        quantity =. num 2{::fields
        key =. id,'/',number week
        reason =. schedule_error (<id),(<week),<quantity
        if. (0=#reason)*.y-:'mps.csv' do.
            if. (<key)e.seen do. reason =. 'duplicate ',id,' week ',number week end.
        end.
        if. #reason do. y record_error (<line),<reason
        else.
            row =. 'item week quantity line' record (<id),(<week),(<quantity),<line
            rows =. rows,<row
            seen =. seen,<key
        end.
    end.
    rows
)
read_inquiries =: 3 : 0
    Inquiries =: 0$a:
    seen =. 0$a:
    for_box. read_rows 'orders.csv' do.
        'line fields' =. >box
        'id item quantitytext weektext' =. fields
        quantity =. num quantitytext
        week =. num weektext
        if. (<id)e.seen do. reason =. 'duplicate order ',id
        else. reason =. schedule_error (<item),(<week),<quantity end.
        if. #reason do. 'orders.csv' record_error (<line),<reason
        else.
            inquiry =. 'id item quantity week line' record (<id),(<item),(<quantity),(<week),<line
            Inquiries =: Inquiries,<inquiry
            seen =. seen,<id
        end.
    end.
    OrderIds =: /:~seen
    i.0
)
read_data =: 3 : 0
    Errors =: 0$a:
    read_params ''
    read_items ''
    ItemIds =: /:~table_keys Items
    read_bom ''
    read_workcenters ''
    read_routings ''
    mps =. read_schedule 'mps.csv'
    receipts =. read_schedule 'receipts.csv'
    read_inquiries ''
    MpsDemands =: 0$a:
    for_box. mps do.
        row =. >box
        values =. (<'item' get_key row),(<'MPS'),(<'week' get_key row),(<'quantity' get_key row),( <''),(<0),( <''),<0
        MpsDemands =: MpsDemands,<new_demand values
    end.
    analyze_bom ''
    Receipts =: Scheduled =: empty_table ''
    for_box. ItemIds do.
        Receipts =: (box,<0$a:) put_key Receipts
        Scheduled =: (box,<Horizon$0) put_key Scheduled
    end.
    keys =. 0 2$0
    for_box. receipts do.
        row =. >box
        keys =. keys,('week' get_key row),'line' get_key row
    end.
    for_box. (/:keys){receipts do.
        row =. >box
        id =. 'item' get_key row
        week =. ('week' get_key row)-1
        quantity =. 'quantity' get_key row
        Receipts =: ((<id),<(id get_key Receipts),box) put_key Receipts
        values =. id get_key Scheduled
        values =. (quantity+week{values) week}values
        Scheduled =: ((<id),<values) put_key Scheduled
    end.
    i.0
)
plan_item =: 3 : 0
    plan =. y
    item =. 'item' get_key plan
    id =. 'id' get_key item
    gross =. Horizon$0
    receipts =. 'receipts' get_key plan
    for_box. 'demands' get_key plan do.
        demand =. >box
        index =. ('week' get_key demand)-1
        gross =. (('quantity' get_key demand)+index{gross) index}gross
    end.
    projected =. 'on_hand' get_key item
    safety =. 'safety_stock' get_key item
    lead =. 'lead_time' get_key item
    onhand =. net =. plannedreceipts =. plannedreleases =. Horizon$0
    orders =. 0$a:
    for_week. i.Horizon do.
        available =. projected+(week{receipts)-week{gross
        projected =. available
        if. available<safety do.
            quantity =. item lot_size (<week),(<available),(<receipts),<gross
            original =. (week+1)-lead
            release =. 1>.original
            values =. (<id),(<1+#orders),(<week+1),(<quantity),(<original),<release
            orders =. orders,<'item number receipt quantity original_release release' record values
            net =. (safety-available) week}net
            plannedreceipts =. quantity week}plannedreceipts
            plannedreleases =. (quantity+(release-1){plannedreleases) (release-1)}plannedreleases
            projected =. available+quantity
        end.
        onhand =. projected week}onhand
    end.
    updates =. 'gross on_hand net planned_receipts planned_releases orders' record (<gross),(<onhand),(<net),(<plannedreceipts),(<plannedreleases),<orders
    for_row. updates do. plan =. row put_key plan end.
    plan
)
work_center_loads =: 3 : 0
    loads =. empty_table ''
    for_box. CenterIds do. loads =. (box,<Horizon$0) put_key loads end.
    for_idbox. PlanningOrder do.
        id =. >idbox
        operations =. id get_key Routings
        lead =. 'lead_time' get_key id get_key Items
        for_orderbox. 'orders' get_key id get_key y do.
            order =. >orderbox
            for_index. i.#operations do.
                operation =. index{::operations
                center =. 'center' get_key operation
                week =. operation_week ('receipt' get_key order),lead,index,#operations
                time =. operation operation_minutes 'quantity' get_key order
                values =. center get_key loads
                values =. (time+(week-1){values) (week-1)}values
                loads =. ((<center),<values) put_key loads
            end.
        end.
    end.
    loads
)
run_mrp =: 3 : 0
    plans =. empty_table ''
    for_box. PlanningOrder do.
        id =. >box
        values =. (<id get_key Items),(<id get_key Scheduled),(<0$a:),(<Horizon$0),(<Horizon$0),(<Horizon$0),(<Horizon$0),(<Horizon$0),<0$a:
        plan =. 'item receipts demands gross on_hand net planned_receipts planned_releases orders' record values
        plans =. ((<id),<plan) put_key plans
    end.
    for_box. MpsDemands,y do.
        demand =. >box
        id =. 'item' get_key demand
        plan =. id get_key plans
        plan =. ((<'demands'),<('demands' get_key plan),box) put_key plan
        plans =. ((<id),<plan) put_key plans
    end.
    for_box. PlanningOrder do.
        id =. >box
        plan =. plan_item id get_key plans
        plans =. ((<id),<plan) put_key plans
        for_orderbox. 'orders' get_key plan do.
            order =. >orderbox
            for_rowbox. id get_key Children do.
                row =. >rowbox
                child =. 'child' get_key row
                values =. (<child),(<'DEPENDENT'),(<'release' get_key order),(<row need 'quantity' get_key order),( <''),(<0),(<id),<'number' get_key order
                demand =. new_demand values
                childplan =. child get_key plans
                childplan =. ((<'demands'),<('demands' get_key childplan),<demand) put_key childplan
                plans =. ((<child),<childplan) put_key plans
            end.
        end.
    end.
    loads =. work_center_loads plans
    overloads =. empty_table ''
    for_box. CenterIds do.
        id =. >box
        available =. 'available' get_key id get_key Centers
        overloads =. ((<id),<0>.(id get_key loads)-available) put_key overloads
    end.
    'items loads overloads' record (<plans),(<loads),<overloads
)
past_due_quantity =: 3 : 0
    quantity =. 0
    for_box. 'orders' get_key y do.
        order =. >box
        if. ('original_release' get_key order)<1 do. quantity =. quantity+'quantity' get_key order end.
    end.
    quantity
)
material_reason =: 4 : 0
    for_box. PlanningOrder do.
        id =. >box
        trial =. past_due_quantity id get_key 'items' get_key y
        current =. past_due_quantity id get_key 'items' get_key x
        if. trial>current do. id return. end.
    end.
    ''
)
capacity_reason =: 4 : 0
    for_box. CenterIds do.
        id =. >box
        trial =. id get_key 'overloads' get_key y
        current =. id get_key 'overloads' get_key x
        found =. I.trial>current
        if. #found do. id,' week ',number 1+{.found return. end.
    end.
    ''
)
promise_inquiries =: 3 : 0
    current =. y
    promised =. promises =. 0$a:
    for_box. Inquiries do.
        inquiry =. >box
        requested =. 'week' get_key inquiry
        promisedweek =. materialweek =. 0
        firstreason =. ''
        for_week. requested+i.1+Horizon-requested do.
            values =. (<'item' get_key inquiry),(<'ORDER'),(<week),(<'quantity' get_key inquiry),(<'id' get_key inquiry),(<'line' get_key inquiry),( <''),<0
            demand =. new_demand values
            trial =. run_mrp promised,<demand
            reason =. current material_reason trial
            if. 0=#reason do.
                if. materialweek=0 do. materialweek =. week end.
                reason =. current capacity_reason trial
            end.
            if. 0=#reason do.
                promisedweek =. week
                promised =. promised,<demand
                current =. trial
                break.
            end.
            if. week=requested do. firstreason =. reason end.
        end.
        promise =. 'inquiry week material_week reason' record (<inquiry),(<promisedweek),(<materialweek),<firstreason
        promises =. promises,<promise
    end.
    (<promises),<current
)
parent_supply =: 4 : 0
    plan =. ('parent' get_key y) get_key x
    indices =. 'order_supply_indices' get_key plan
    index =. (('parent_number' get_key y)-1){indices
    index{::'supplies' get_key plan
)
sort_demands =: 3 : 0
    keys =. 0 5$0
    for_box. y do.
        demand =. >box
        key =. ('week' get_key demand),(DemandKinds i.<'kind' get_key demand),('line' get_key demand),(ItemIds i.<'parent' get_key demand),'parent_number' get_key demand
        keys =. keys,key
    end.
    (/:keys){y
)
sorted_roots =: 3 : 0
    roots =. 0$a:
    keys =. 0$a:
    sortkeys =. 0 4$0
    for_box. y do.
        root =. >box
        key =. (<'item' get_key root),(<'kind' get_key root),(<'week' get_key root),<'order_id' get_key root
        if. (<key)e.keys do. continue. end.
        keys =. keys,<key
        roots =. roots,box
        numeric =. (ItemIds i.<'item' get_key root),(RootKinds i.<'kind' get_key root),('week' get_key root),OrderIds i.<'order_id' get_key root
        sortkeys =. sortkeys,numeric
    end.
    (/:sortkeys){roots
)
new_supply =: 3 : 0
    'kind week quantity line order' =. y
    'kind week quantity line order remaining allocations roots' record (<kind),(<week),(<quantity),(<line),(<order),(<quantity),(<0$a:),<0$a:
)
peg_plan =: 3 : 0
    plan =. y
    plans =. 'items' get_key plan
    for_idbox. PlanningOrder do.
        id =. >idbox
        itemplan =. id get_key plans
        item =. 'item' get_key itemplan
        demands =. sort_demands 'demands' get_key itemplan
        safety =. 'safety_stock' get_key item
        if. safety>0 do.
